Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Svi Mykhailiuk?

Svi Mykhailiuk is 29 years old.

Where was Svi Mykhailiuk born?

Svi Mykhailiuk was born in Cherkasy, Ukraine.

When was Svi Mykhailiuk born?

Svi Mykhailiuk was born on June 10, 1997.

How tall is Svi Mykhailiuk?

Svi Mykhailiuk is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much does Svi Mykhailiuk weigh?

Svi Mykhailiuk weighs 205 lbs (92 kg).

Is Svi Mykhailiuk in the Hall of Fame?

Svi Mykhailiuk is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Svi Mykhailiuk drafted?

Svi Mykhailiuk was drafted by Los Angeles Lakers, 2nd round (17th pick, 47th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Svi Mykhailiuk play?

Small Forward.

What is Svi Mykhailiuk's net worth?

Svi Mykhailiuk has made at least $19,207,140 playing professional basketball.

How much does Svi Mykhailiuk make?

Svi Mykhailiuk made $3,675,000 in 2026.

How many rings does Svi Mykhailiuk have?

Svi Mykhailiuk has won one championship.

What is Svi Mykhailiuk's Instagram account?

Svi Mykhailiuk is on Instagram at Sviat_10.

What schools did Svi Mykhailiuk attend?

Svi Mykhailiuk attended Cherkasy First City Gymnasia in Cherkasy, Ukraine and Kansas.

What are Svi Mykhailiuk's nicknames?

Ukraine Maker is a nickname for Svi Mykhailiuk.
